svg.title: Near-shore traffic peaks off Houston-Galveston, New York, and Los Angeles-Long Beach

cc:Work.dc:title: Near-shore traffic peaks off Houston-Galveston, New York, and Los Angeles-Long Beach
cc:Work.dc:description: Three bar charts of near-shore large-ship traffic along the Pacific, Gulf, and Atlantic coasts; each has one or two clear peaks at the major port complexes.
